title: Inverse problem: permittivity of a slab from its reflection spectrum (1D)
description: A dielectric slab of unknown permittivity and loss is measured in reflection: the 'measurement' is a 1-D FDTD run (with the CPML, the scheme's dispersion and added receiver noise), the model is the transfer-matrix reflection of pp.em.waves.multilayer. Least squares recovers eps_r and the conductivity with their covariance. The model lacks the scheme's dispersion, which biases the fit by about one standard uncertainty: the instrument is simulated at the fitted point and the bias of that noiseless refit is removed, with its own uncertainty. The recovered values are compared with the truth the measurement was generated from (hidden from the fit), and the fit is repeated on noise realisations to check the stated uncertainty (coverage, centring).

metrics.name: rel_error[1D: eps_r recovered vs truth]
metrics.how: |computed - reference| / |reference| (ground_truth: the permittivity the FDTD measurement was generated with (hidden from the fit))

metrics.name: 1D: eps_r_fit_uncorrected
metrics.how: least squares on the noisy FDTD reflection spectrum

metrics.name: 1D: eps_r_model_bias
metrics.how: fit of the noiseless FDTD spectrum simulated at the fitted point, minus that point (the transfer-matrix model lacks the FDTD dispersion)

metrics.name: 1D: eps_r_recovered
metrics.how: fit minus the model bias; u combines the fit and the bias

metrics.name: 1D: model_error_max
metrics.how: max |r_FDTD - r_model| at the true parameters (no noise)

metrics.name: 1D: coverage_2u_eps_uncorrected
metrics.how: fraction of 100 noise realisations within 2 u, fit alone (no bias correction)

metrics.name: 1D: coverage_2u_eps
metrics.how: fraction of 100 noise realisations within 2 u, bias corrected

metrics.name: 1D: mean_z
metrics.how: mean of (eps_corrected - eps_true) / u, bias corrected

checks.name: [1D] eps_r recovered vs truth
checks.detail: the permittivity the FDTD measurement was generated with (hidden from the fit)
checks.label: eps_r recovered vs truth vs ground truth

checks.name: [1D] sigma recovered vs truth
checks.label: sigma recovered vs truth vs ground truth

checks.name: [1D] FDTD measurement and transfer-matrix model agree below the noise
[1D] stated u(eps) consistent with the scatter (std of z between 0.7 and 1.5)
checks.detail: z = (eps_corrected - eps_true) / u; its std is 1 when u is right

checks.name: [1D] 2 u covers the truth about 95 % of the time
checks.detail: 97/100, Wilson 95 % interval 0.915-0.990; without the bias correction 0.90

references: Baker-Jarvis et al., NIST Technical Note 1536 (2004), transmission/reflection methods
Born & Wolf, Principles of Optics, 7th ed., sec. 1.6 (characteristic matrices)
